name: mobilezone holding ag
summary: mobilezone holding ag, together with its subsidiaries, provides mobile and fixed-line telephony, digital television (TV), and internet services for various network operators in Germany and Switzerland. The company also sells mobile communication devices, such as mobile phones, used and refurbished smartphones, watches, tablets, and wearables, as well as related accessories; and offers subscription for mobile and landline telephony, TV, and internet.
